title.narrative: Assistance d’urgence aux populations déplacées et aux communautés hôtes affectées par les crises sécuritaires et les catastrophes liées au climat au Niger (abris, articles non alimentaires et eau, hygiène et assainissement (EAH)

description.narrative: The main objective of this IOM project is to provide humanitarian assistance to the most vulnerable populations affected by armed conflict and natural disasters with shelter, non-food items and WASH assistance in order to improve their living conditions and dignity. The project provides assistance to IDPs and host communities in the communities of Boudouri, Digargo, Banibangou, Ouallama, Diffa and Chétimari, by constructing emergency shelter, distributing non-food items, building integrated latrine and showers and mini-water supply systems. The intervention provides humanitarian assistance to 21,779 people (4,704 men, 5,096 women and 11,979 children), including 856 persons with disabilities.
